meta.purpose: Canonical, fully-attributed examples - one per node type plus representative edges. The SHAPE (fields, enums, bitemporal pairs) is normative per rise-node-taxonomy.md v0.1 and rise-relationship-taxonomy.md v0.3. Attribute VALUES are illustrative unless verification says 'verified'. Companion file rise-nodes-and-edges.json holds the full 218-node seed dataset with a lighter attribute set; on import, expand seed nodes to these shapes with system defaults.
meta.bitemporal_convention: effective_from/effective_to = when true in the world (valid time). recorded_at/superseded_at = when the database believed it (transaction time, system-set). Open effective_to and null superseded_at = current.
